content.comment_body: I'm looking for a solution to a related issue. I want to compare a value contained in VM (variable memory) with a value from an up/down counter. If the VM value exceeds the counter, output should be 1; if it's less, output should be 2. Any assistance with this would be appreciated. Best regards, [user_name].
I've provided an attachment with a possible solution.
Thank you for the assistance. The solution works perfectly.
